verification.method: scripts/verify/rankings-gdp.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/) and UN WPP 2024 file, not the site's generated data; then the text was read by hand
verification.what: every ranking row (186 economies, order and GDP per person), PPP ranks, the CSV, every figure in the answer, cards, story, chart, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD; claims: top five, bottom three, US first among 20 million+, share of people below the world average (UN WPP 2025 populations), China vs world average, Monaco and Liechtenstein not ranked
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0); UN WPP 2024
verification.result: All automated comparisons matched (793 across both pages); wording that could not be sourced was removed
